sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The "Shramashakthi Special Women's Scheme" is a special scheme for the economic empowerment of widowed, divorced, unmarried women of the minority community.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Women and Child; Sector: Loan

**Detailed Description:** The "Shramashakthi Special Women's Scheme" was launched by the Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka, and implemented by the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation. This is a special scheme for the economic empowerment of widowed, divorced, unmarried women of the minority community. Under this scheme, ₹25,000/- loan and ₹25,000/- subsidy will be provided to undertake various economic activities.
**Benefits / Assistance:** > **Financial Assistance:** - A total of ₹50,000/- is provided, comprising ₹25,000/- as a loan and ₹25,000/- as a subsidy.

**Application Process:** Step-01: Applicant need to visits the Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation [official website](https://kmdconline.karnataka.gov.in/Portal/home). Step-02: Click "[Apply Online](https://kmdconline.karnataka.gov.in/Portal/login)&quot
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Karnataka Minorities Development Corporation; Nodal Department: Minorities Welfare Department
**Tags:** Loan, Economic Empowerment, Women, Minority Community
